batch: 2 (chs 7-10, the temple sermon, the balm, boasting in knowing God, idols)

units.characteristics: false religious security; the sanctuary as talisman divorced from the heart
units.gist: GEM - the temple sermon: 'do not trust in these DECEPTIVE WORDS, This is the TEMPLE OF THE LORD'; 'will you STEAL, MURDER, commit adultery... and then come and stand before me and say, WE ARE DELIVERED?'; 'a den of robbers'; 'obey my voice... but they walked in the STUBBORNNESS of their evil hearts, and went BACKWARD and not forward' - religion trusted as a charm while the conduct and heart are corrupt

units.characteristics: the refusal to return; no 'what have I done?'; the balm-in-Gilead lament
units.gist: THE GEM - 'why has this people turned away in PERPETUAL BACKSLIDING? they hold fast to deceit, they REFUSE TO RETURN'; 'no man relents of his evil, saying, WHAT HAVE I DONE?' (no self-examination); the stork knows her times but 'my people know not the rules of the LORD'; the prophet's grief 'my heart is SICK within me'; 'IS THERE NO BALM IN GILEAD? is there no physician? why has the health of my people not been restored?'

units.characteristics: the one legitimate boast - knowing God; the weeping prophet; refusing to know God
units.gist: THE GEM - 'oh that my head were WATERS, my eyes a FOUNTAIN OF TEARS, that I might weep'; 'they REFUSE TO KNOW ME'; 'let not the WISE man boast in his wisdom, the MIGHTY in his might, the RICH in his riches, BUT LET HIM WHO BOASTS BOAST IN THIS, THAT HE KNOWS ME, that I am the LORD who practices STEADFAST LOVE, JUSTICE, RIGHTEOUSNESS - for in these I DELIGHT'; 'uncircumcised in HEART'

units.characteristics: dead carried idols vs the living God; God as portion; the way of man not in himself
units.gist: GEM - idols 'like SCARECROWS... they cannot speak, they must be CARRIED, they cannot walk... cannot do evil nor good'; 'there is none like you, O LORD... the LORD is the TRUE GOD, the LIVING GOD'; 'the LORD is the PORTION of Jacob'; the prophet 'this is an affliction, and I must BEAR it'; 'I know, O LORD, that the WAY OF MAN IS NOT IN HIMSELF, that it is not in man to DIRECT HIS STEPS. CORRECT me, but in justice'
